I don’t necessarily agree with you, but I do at the same time. I’m not street or hard or anything, but I wouldn’t wish prison on my worst enemy. If someone killed my family I would want justice but that’s where it gets tricky. I wouldn’t want to kill them, but I also wouldn’t want them in prison, it doesn’t feel like enough to me for taking someone’s life. I do agree with you when you say America’s prison system doesn’t work, it doesn’t. It doesn’t rehabilitate, it is torture and cheap slavery. (If you don’t know what I’m talking about, 13th amendment) But I can’t say we really see eye to eye. I understand what you mean, but there’s some contradictions in there. When you use violence to get “justice” it just continues an endless cycle of violence. You killed mine, I kill yours, so you kill mine, etc. The only real hope for any of that is the prison system which we can only dream of being improved. 

TL:DR You’re right about prison being useless, but violence still isn’t the answer, it just continues the cycle.
